items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Caliphas directly; the name is only brought up by the interviewer in the context of a venue ('C-Roll, Caliphas?').

ctx.x: I played with his band a while. And then uh, moved Johnny Censier. He come back from uh, out of Chicago. And then he started. After I left out of there, I started back my own group. And I played my own group up until, well up at the present, I get a little gist when I usually work a lot by myself. You know, entertain guitar and band. I played with them. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. And sing. When did you switch…
See, they went to C-Rolls? Yeah. C-Roll, Caliphas?

Yeah, he had a band placed down there and there was two, it was Dublin. Well I stayed with John Patterson, Big Joe and Lil Joe used to be announcers for the radio, you know, over, over, uh, Schumacher's, you used to call it, the Royal Rendezvous, and then they changed the name to Parisian Gardens, later, you know.
